title: Still Early into Development Survival/Automation - Collab?
author: euthanize
selftext:
Took Inspiration from Planet Crafter + Satisfactory + StarCraft 2.

  
Zerg like Humanoid lands on this green planet wanting to terraform it to make it livable for it's species.

  
This is about 2 months of casual coding after work. Obviously open to criticism, so let me hear it. And if anyone would like to possibly join in on the project willing to discuss as well. Using Unity, Claude and Codex Sono and Eleven Labs for this. Art, environment and animations still the largest hurdle. 

  
No AI was used to write this post.
